items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: And I saw Wayne with Art Blakey and Freddie Hubbard and Curtis Fuller and Jimmy Merritt.

ctx.x: It’s a shame. You know by the time I saw Miles it was with Wayne. And I saw Wayne with Art Blakey and Freddie Hubbard and Curtis Fuller and Jimmy Merritt. Cedar Walton.
Did you ever feel like you were born a little too late?
